findings.current: If you resist, I promise you an end more horrific than any you have ever seen.
findings.defect: The Korean describes an end never seen anywhere; the English instead compares it to what the listeners themselves have seen.
findings.rationale: 그 어디에서도 본 적 없는 means “never seen anywhere,” while 가장 끔찍한 is a superlative. The current wording narrows the claim to the audience’s personal experience.
findings.replacement: If you resist, I promise you the most horrific end ever seen anywhere.

summary: The assembled chapter is faithful overall, with one minor shift in the surrender warning’s scope.
